final: WITH oc AS (SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id) SELECT oc.account_id, d.A3 AS region, oc.n AS num_orders, oc.n - (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) FROM oc) AS diff FROM oc JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
